title: Waypoint Temporal Attachment
description: Optional temporal descriptor for an entity or relationship.

at.description: ISO-8601 instant when kind is instant.

start.description: ISO-8601 start when kind is interval.

end.description: ISO-8601 end when kind is interval. Open-ended if omitted.

seasons.description: Named seasonal windows when kind is seasonal.

relative.description: Qualitative timing when kind is relative, e.g. after-rain, before-leaf-out.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when local wall time matters.

label.description: Optional human label, e.g. Early spring morel window.
